show.description: Mumbai’s powerful businessman Ashok Prajapati hides his billionaire identity to raise his daughter Simmi with values. But when they are humiliated at her college by a rich family trying to buy her science award, Ashok uncovers a shocking truth—his wife Shalaka has been living a double life with them using his wealth. As greed, betrayal, and inheritance wars erupt, Ashok must choose revenge or protect Simmi’s future.
